theorems.name: Submission.frt_carrier_nullMeasurable
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), M ⊆ U → V.weight Mᶜ = 0 → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) → NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
